secondaryValue: Verbose, Standard, Minimal, OTC Only, Off
fieldDescription:
Controls how much C2 chatter is shown on the in-game HUD combat feed (starsector.log always records all verbose telemetry):
- Verbose: All enabled signals with full tactical reason suffixes and opening division formation lines.
- Standard: Concise 1-line messages (no parenthetical reason clutter), skips opening formation spam and routine re-targeting, and uses longer HUD cooldowns.
- Minimal: Only OTC phase/order signals and critical friendly division plays (Time-on-Target strikes, crisis relief, hauling out to vent).
- OTC Only: Only Battle Group Commander (OTC) phase and order signals; mutes individual division chatter on screen.
- Off: Mutes all on-screen C2 HUD chatter.
